channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Badshah admits making Rs.12.45 crore impulse buy; here's what he bought
item.description: In 2025, Badshah made headlines for making a huge purchase. He recently opened up about this and spoke about how the excitement after buying the object barely lasted for 10-15 minutes.

item.title: Mana Shankara Varaprasad Garu inches closer to Rs 400 crore gross mark at worldwide box office
item.description: Mana Shankara Varaprasad Garu (MSVG) has continued its successful march and inched closer to Rs 400 crore gross mark at the worldwide box office in 15 days.

item.title: Dhurandhar box office collection: Ranveer Singh's film surpasses Rs 890 crore net mark in India
item.description: Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar is undeterred by new release Border 2, as it has continued to make decent collection and surpassed Rs 890 crore net mark at the Indian box office.

item.title: Republic Day controversy: BJP slams Rahul Gandhi over 'patka', calls it hateful mindset
item.description: Political controversies marked Republic Day celebrations as the BJP and Congress clashed over separate incidents. The BJP accused Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi of showing disrespect to the Northeast by allegedly refusing to wear a traditional 'patka' despite a request from President Droupadi Murmu, calling it evidence of a "hateful mindset." Congress leaders rejected the charge, saying several leaders, including BJP members, did not wear the attire and the issue was being politicised.

item.title: 'Aashiqon Ki Colony' song review: Shahid Kapoor kisses Disha Patani, sensual dance in O Romeo fails to impress
item.description: In the song Aashiqon Ki Colony, Shahid Kapoor is seen in a rugged, tattooed look, while Disha Patani, as usual, flaunts her dance moves. However, netizens were not impressed and called Shahid and Disha's on-screen chemistry cold.

item.title: Samantha attends Republic Day reception at Rashtrapati Bhavan; meets PM Modi, President Murmu [reactions]
item.description: Samantha Ruth Prabhu attended the Republic Day at-home reception at Rashtrapati Bhavan and later shared an emotional Instagram post, expressing gratitude and reflecting on her journey, saying she kept showing up and remains forever grateful for the moment.

item.title: Fresh snowfall disrupts normalcy in Kashmir; flights cancelled, highway closed, avalanche alert issued
item.description: Fresh snowfall across the Kashmir Valley on Tuesday brought road, rail and air traffic to a halt, forcing the closure of the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway, cancellation of all flights from Srinagar Airport and prompting avalanche warnings in several districts, while the government initiated action against engineers over snow clearance lapses.

item.title: Border 3 confirmed amid success of Sunny Deol's Border 2; fans ask if it'll be 'based on Operation Sindoor?'
item.description: Following the massive success of Border 2, the makers have announced Border 3, but the news has drawn mixed reactions from fans, with many expressing concern over what the sequel would hold and questioning whether the film will be based on Operation Sindoor.

item.title: Arijit Singh retires from playback singing after singing for Salman Khan's Battle of Galwan; fans say 'end of an era'
item.description: Arijit Singh has announced that he is stepping away from Bollywood playback singing, sharing the news on X just days after the release of his latest track Maatrubhumi from Salman Khan's Battle of Galwan, along with his recent song "Hum Toh Tere Hi Liye The" from O Romeo. Arijit shared on social media that he will now focus on Indian classical music.

item.title: Special train runs between Katra and Srinagar as flights, highway remain shut amid heavy snowfall
item.description: With flights cancelled and the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway closed due to heavy snowfall, Northern Railway operated special trains between Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra and Srinagar on Tuesday, enabling more than 1,400 stranded passengers, including tourists, to travel safely despite harsh weather conditions.
